references.text: Wise women build their houses, a contrast to the wise women who served Sisera's mother
Wisdom personified as a woman speaking, similar to the wise women who give counsel
A wise woman from Tekoa who spoke with wisdom to the king, similar to the court women who answered
A wise woman who spoke and gave advice, parallel to the wise court women
Esther and her maidservants in the palace, similar to the scene of court women serving
The noble woman who opens her mouth with wisdom, parallel to the wise women who answer
